shared_elements: incised/carved linear figuration on a rock surface
elongated hull- or garment-like forms with rows of short parallel strokes along an edge
repeated small parallel marks forming a fringe or comb-like row
justification: Both surfaces carry linear carved forms in which a long curved or straight edge is bordered by a row of short repeated strokes (the pleated hem/fringe of the robe in A, the comb-like rows along the boat-like outlines in B), which is a fairly generic correspondence. Otherwise the content differs entirely: A shows naturalistic, high-relief human figures in ceremonial dress with hands, staves and a band of rosettes below, while B shows flat, schematic outline motifs with no human anatomy, no rosettes and no framing register.
